about: Labelled MCQs on benchmark/notes.md for checking the quality gate. PROVISIONAL LABELS: written by an AI session from the definitions in docs/QUESTION_QUALITY.md, not yet reviewed by people. Before using the numbers in a report, have two raters re-label every item independently (good / bad and the defect), settle disagreements, and record agreement. 'defect' is the main problem of a bad item: ambiguous, missing-context, multiple-correct, weak-distractors, unsupported, wrong-key, trivial, format.

items.label: good
items.prompt: Which of the following is a situation in which every process in a set is waiting for an event that only another process in the set can cause?
items.supportingExcerpt: A deadlock is a situation in which every process in a set is waiting for an event that can be caused only by another process in the set.

items.label: good
items.prompt: Process P1 holds resource R1 and requests R2, while process P2 holds R2 and requests R1. Neither resource can be taken away from the process holding it. Which situation can arise?
items.supportingExcerpt: A deadlock is a situation in which every process in a set is waiting for an event that can be caused only by another process in the set.

items.label: good
items.prompt: Which transport protocol provides connectionless, best-effort delivery of datagrams?

items.label: good
items.prompt: For resistors in series the total resistance is given by $R = R1 + R2$. What is $R$ when $R1 = 4$ and $R2 = 6$?
items.supportingExcerpt: For resistors in series the total resistance is R = R1 + R2, and the same current flows through each resistor.

items.label: good
items.prompt: Which statement describes “isolation”?
options: each transaction is unaware of other transactions executing concurrently
either all operations of a transaction are reflected in the database or none are
after a transaction commits, its changes persist even if the system fails
a transaction takes the database from one consistent state to another
items.answerKey: each transaction is unaware of other transactions executing concurrently
items.supportingExcerpt: Isolation: each transaction is unaware of other transactions executing concurrently.

items.prompt: Why is MD5 no longer considered secure?
